name: Toudou Aki
source:
Zodiac: Cancer

The main bodyguard for the mansion.

His family are born and raised as boxers, but he decided to drift from this life, ending at the mansion. His dream in life is to be "the strongest man in Asia"; however, he feels this path can be reached in a different way then his family believes. 

His strength is endless, proven constantly by his heavy lifting. He lacks civility and often talks tough but to the point.
